title: Gimbal recorded by Ryan Graves' squadron VFA-11

tellings.quote: this is Ryan Grave Squadron. I think it's VFA1, the Red Rippers.

plain: The Gimbal video, a 2015 Navy recording off Florida of an unexplained object that seems to rotate in the air, was filmed by the squadron of a Navy fighter pilot named Ryan Graves. The analyst Marik von Rennenkampff says so on Michels's show, calling it Graves's squadron, which he names as "VFA1, the Red Rippers" (the Navy fighter squadron VFA-11). It ties the famous video to a pilot who has spoken publicly about such sightings.
